Working notes — desk assignment requests

Scope: REQ-2401–REQ-2410 ask to assign shipment/refund/claim/invoice requests to desks A (standard queue), B (priority desk), or C (regional office).

Observed cases vary by region (north/south/east), size (small/large), request type, and sender (Client Services, Field Sales, Partner Accounts, Regional Ops, Finance Desk).

Chosen action C failed/returned +0.00 for REQ-2402–REQ-2410: “option C is not valid for this request.” Do not select C for these assignments, even when the ticket mentions regional origin/office or comes from Regional Ops.

One adjacent outcome for REQ-2401 notes option B is not valid. Treat B as uncertain/possibly invalid until confirmed. A remains untested.

No evidence that region, size, request type, sender, or subject wording changes validity of C.

Future strategy: avoid C. If forced to assign, test/confirm A vs B using a fresh ticket and record the first accepted option.

Working notes — desk assignment requests

Scope: REQ-2401–REQ-2420; assign to A (standard), B (priority), or C (regional).

C: invalid for all observed requests (REQ-2402–REQ-2410; also a C-invalid message tied to REQ-2411). Never select C, even when the ticket mentions south/north/east region, regional office, or Regional Ops.

B: only evidence is REQ-2401 adjacent rejection (“option B not valid”). Treat B as uncertain/possibly invalid until confirmed.

A: now tested. Accepted for:
- small refund, south region: REQ-2411–REQ-2414. Sender varied (Field Sales, Regional Ops, Client Services) and wording varied; A worked.
- small claim, north region, from Regional Ops with “came in through regional office”: REQ-2415.

A rejected for:
- small claim, north, Finance Desk, “scanned, not typed”: REQ-2416.
- small shipment, south, Field Sales, second attempt: REQ-2417.
- large invoice, east, Field Sales, scanned paperwork: REQ-2418.
- small claim, south, Regional Ops, EOD urgency: REQ-2419.
- large refund, north, Regional Ops, “same as last month”: REQ-2420.

So A is not universal. Region, size, request type, and sender/wording can change validity; sender appears relevant for north claims.

Future strategy: For small south refunds, use A. For small north claims from Regional Ops with regional-office wording, use A. Otherwise, avoid C and test B on a fresh ticket; record whether B is accepted. Do not assume regional origin/office language makes C valid. If B also fails, reassess.

Working notes — desk assignment requests (REQ-2401–REQ-2430)

Scope: assign A (standard), B (priority), or C (regional).

C: invalid for all observed requests. Never select C, even when ticket mentions region, regional office, or Regional Ops.

A: narrow. Confirmed for small south refunds (REQ-2411–2414) and small north claim from Regional Ops with regional-office wording (REQ-2415). A rejected for many other cases (REQ-2416–2420), including north Finance claims, south Regional Ops claims, east invoices, and north Regional Ops refunds. A is not universal.

B: no longer merely uncertain. Accepted for:
- large north claim, Regional Ops, “same as last month” (REQ-2421)
- small north refund, Partner Accounts, second attempt (REQ-2429)

B rejected for:
- large south refund, Partner Accounts, EOD (REQ-2424)
- small south claim, Partner Accounts, EOD (REQ-2425)
- large north shipment, Field Sales, regional office (REQ-2430)

Earlier B-invalid note for REQ-2401 remains an exception. B appears valid for north claims/refunds, invalid for south claims/refunds and at least north shipments. Do not generalize.

D/other: logs sometimes show “D” attempts/feedback despite A/B/C options; inconsistent and not reliable. Act only on offered options.

Future strategy:
- Never C.
- For north claims/refunds, try B first unless a prior exception applies.
- For small south refunds, use A.
- For small north claims from Regional Ops with regional-office wording, use A.
- Shipments remain unresolved: B failed large north shipment; C invalid; test A cautiously or reassess.
- Record outcome; if B fails, do not retry blindly.

Working notes — desk assignment requests (REQ-2401–REQ-2440)

Scope: assign A (standard), B (priority), or C (regional).

C: invalid for all observed requests. Never select C, even with regional wording.

A:
- Confirmed: small south refunds (2411–2414); small north claim from Regional Ops with regional-office wording (2415); small east claim (2431); large south claim from Client Services (2439).
- Rejected/invalid: many north Finance claims, south Regional Ops claims, east invoices including large east invoice (2438), east large claim (2440), north small shipment attempt (2437). A is not universal.

B:
- Confirmed: large north claim, Regional Ops, “same as last month” (2421); small north refund, Partner Accounts, second attempt (2429); small north refund, Client Services, regional-office wording (2436).
- Rejected/invalid: large south refund, Partner Accounts, EOD (2424); small south claim, Partner Accounts, EOD (2425); large north shipment, Field Sales (2430); small east refund (2433).
- REQ-2401 remains an earlier exception.

Other: logs sometimes show “D” despite A/B/C options; ignore as unreliable. Act only on offered options.

Future strategy:
- Never C.
- North claims/refunds: try B first unless a prior exception applies; A can work for small north claim via Regional Ops with regional-office wording.
- South: small refunds use A; large claim from Client Services can use A. B generally invalid for south claims/refunds.
- East: small claim use A. East invoices and large claims: A invalid; B not confirmed.
- Shipments remain unresolved: B failed large north shipment; A attempted north small shipment unsuccessfully. Test cautiously or reassess.
- Record outcome; if B fails, do not blindly retry.

Working notes — desk assignment requests (REQ-2401–REQ-2450)

Scope: assign A (standard), B (priority), or C (regional).

C: not always invalid. New evidence suggests C can be correct when A and B both fail/invalid, especially south Finance claims, east large claims/invoices/refunds, and large south refunds. Test C when A/B invalid.

A:
- Valid: small south refunds (2411–2414); small north claim Regional Ops/regional wording (2415); small east claim (2431); large south claim Client Services (2439); large north shipment Finance (2445); small south invoice Partner Accounts (2449).
- Invalid: many north Finance claims; south Regional Ops claims; east invoices incl. large east invoice (2438, 2447); east large claim (2440, 2446); north small shipment (2437); small south claim Finance (2441); large south claim Finance (2442); large south refund Field Sales (2450); large east refund Partner (2443).

B:
- Valid: large north claim Regional Ops (2421); small north refund Partner Accounts (2429); small north refund Client Services/regional wording (2436); small north claim Finance (2448).
- Invalid: large south refund Partner Accounts EOD (2424); small south claim Partner Accounts EOD (2425); large north shipment Field Sales (2430); small east refund (2433); small north invoice Field Sales (2444); large east claim Partner (2446); large east invoice Finance (2447); large east refund Partner (2443).

Shipments: A works for large north shipment Finance (2445). B failed large north shipment Field Sales. Small north shipment unresolved.

Strategy:
- North claims/refunds: B often works; A sometimes (Regional Ops/regional wording). North invoices: avoid B; A untested.
- South: small refunds/invoices use A. Large claim Client Services use A. Finance claims and large refunds: A/B fail; try C.
- East: small claim use A. Large claims, large invoices, refunds: A/B fail; try C.
- Record outcome; if A/B fail, do not blindly retry; consider C.

Working notes — desk assignment REQ-2401–2459

Scope: assign A (standard), B (priority), C (regional).

General: C is not always invalid; test C when A/B fail, especially east large claims/invoices/refunds and south Finance. C fails for small east invoice/shipment and some large south refunds.

A valid: small south refunds (2411–2414, 2451–2452); small north claim Regional Ops/regional wording (2415); small east claim (2431); large south claim Client Services (2439); large north shipment Finance (2445); small south invoice Partner Accounts (2449); small north invoice (2453).
A invalid: many north Finance claims; south Regional Ops claims; east invoices incl. large (2438, 2447); large east claim (2440, 2446); north small shipment (2437); small south claim Finance (2441); large south claim Finance (2442); large south refund Field Sales (2450); large east refund Partner (2443); small east refund (2455); small east shipment (2457); small south shipment (2459).

B valid: large north claim Regional Ops (2421); small north refund Partner Accounts (2429); small north refund Client Services/regional wording (2436); small north claim Finance (2448).
B invalid: large south refund Partner Accounts EOD (2424); small south claim Partner Accounts EOD (2425); large north shipment Field Sales (2430); small east refund (2433); small north invoice Field Sales (2444); large east claim Partner (2446); large east invoice Finance (2447); large east refund Partner (2443).

C valid: large east invoice (2456); likely large east claims/refunds when A/B fail; south Finance claims.
C invalid: small east invoice (2454); small east shipment (2457); large south refund Regional Ops (2458); also indicated invalid for small east refund (2455) and small south shipment (2459).

Strategy:
North: claims/refunds B often; A sometimes (Regional Ops/regional wording). Invoices A works for small north; avoid B.
South: small refunds/invoices A. Large claim Client Services A. Finance claims and large refunds: A/B/C may fail; do not blindly retry. Small shipment: A/C invalid; try B.
East: small claim A. Large invoice C. Large claims/refunds: try C if A/B fail. Small invoice/shipment: avoid C. Small refund: A/B failed.
Record outcome; if A/B fail, consider C only where supported.
